_about: Public-domain Henry W. Soltau (Henry William Soltau, 1805-1875, Brethren) for the Word Hoard: 4 books on the tabernacle and the gospel from Internet Archive scans: The Holy Vessels and Furniture of the Tabernacle, A Full Exposition of the Tabernacle and the Priestly Garments (issued in parts from 1864), The Tabernacle, the Priesthood, and the Offerings (posthumous Morgan and Scott printing) and The Soul and its Difficulties. All undated on the title page. Raw OCR. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 20 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
